From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Ops gate: account credentialing, SSH jumpbox & access priming

Hi Marco —

Thanks for agreeing to a short runbook handoff this week. Before we flip the switch on the private deployment we need to prime a few account-level items on your side so day-one ops can land cleanly. I pulled together the core asks below — please confirm owners and expected ETA. I attached a rough network diagram (network-diagram-v2.pdf) to illustrate the routing we discussed.

1) Account credentialing
   - Service account with Cloud IAM role: compute.networkAdmin + storage.objectViewer
   - Dedicated customer KMS key created with grant to redwood-service@redwood.ai
   - SRE contact + emergency pager number

2) SSH jumpbox / bastion plan
   - We require a single managed jumpbox for initial access; provide allowed CIDR for jumpbox management and list of admin public keys (csv)
   - Please confirm whether you want us to provision the jumpbox or if you'll supply an existing host (we prefer provisioning to ensure configured hardening)

3) Network priming & egress
   - Egress allowlist (IPs + FQDNs) for Redwood runtime, collector, and metrics endpoints
   - NAT/proxy details if present

4) Evidence for audit (quick list)
   - SOC2 scoping notes for the enclave, proof of KMS creation, example audit log link

Next steps: if you can confirm owners by EOD Wednesday I’ll schedule a 30-min operational walk-through with Grace and Ben (we'll show the onboarding checklist and required artifacts).

Attachments: network-diagram-v2.pdf

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0114

Marco / Karthik —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few operational clarifications from the onboarding checklist:

- Jumpbox hardening: If Redwood provisions the jumpbox we will install our standard audit agents, an allowlist for inbound management IPs, and enforce key-only SSH. Please confirm if Ops is comfortable with our audit agent; it's lightweight and required for session capture during early support windows.

- KMS grant scope: we need a grant that allows Encrypt/Decrypt for the redwood-service principle only; please ensure no broad roles (e.g., projectOwner) are included. A KMS key policy snippet would be ideal.

- Egress FQDNs: we'll need these resolved to IP ranges before cutoff. If you can't provide numeric ranges we can accept proxy FQDNs and we'll route through your proxy.

I'll draft an account-priming-checklist.xlsx and share later today with the fields we'll capture during provisioning (owners, access proofs, link to audit artifacts).

—Grace
Grace Oconnor
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference

- Ops has agreed to let Redwood provision the jumpbox on 2028-08-05 in the 09:00–12:00 PT window. Marco, please confirm preferred AM time (09:00 or 10:00 PT).
- Marco to provide numeric egress ranges or proxy FQDNs by 2028-08-02; Grace will reconcile with our allowlist and publish final egress rule set.

I've attached the priming checklist (account-priming-checklist.xlsx) for Lina to fill; it contains the KMS ARN field, admin key confirmation, and a link back to INF-4821 for the provisioning ticket.

If we get confirmations on KMS + egress ranges today we'll proceed with provisioning on Monday. If anything blocks, escalate to Ben and he will open an expedited procurement hold.

Best —
